need: Frontend delivery and repair must prefer a UI library's supported public props, variants and slot APIs before adding class or CSS overrides, so vendor state behavior remains authoritative and upgrades stay tractable.
negativeBoundary: Do not ban necessary overrides when the public API cannot express the approved behavior; require a documented API gap and bounded proof instead.
acceptanceCriteria: The shared Checkbox uses HeroUI's supported variant prop for the semantic default resting background instead of overriding Checkbox.Control with bg-default.
Frontend mutation guidance requires checking public component props, variants and slot APIs before class or CSS overrides.
Executable contract tests reject an undocumented style override when a supported vendor prop expresses the same behavior.

accepts: Use HeroUI public props and variants before overriding component styles.
Use the Checkbox secondary variant because it maps the unchecked control to the semantic default token while preserving vendor-owned states.
rejects: Add bg-default directly to Checkbox.Control when HeroUI already exposes a variant for that behavior.
Override vendor component internals without first proving and recording a public-API gap.

review.rationale: The correction is proven and the public HeroUI variant preserves vendor-owned unchecked, checked and focus-visible behavior; publish the vendor-props-first rule to the StarCi runtime immediately.
